svg.title: ZooKeeper RequestProcessor pipeline architecture
svg.desc: Three explicit chained RequestProcessor pipelines in ZooKeeper: standalone server pipeline, Leader pipeline, and Follower pipeline (with parallel log chain). Each processor handles one responsibility and passes the request forward.
svg.text: RequestProcessor interface — "Requests always move forward through the chain" · RequestProcessor.java

svg.text: One responsibility per filter: prepare · log · propose · commit · track · apply — request always moves forward
